verdicts.originalText: The Hold-E variant (Aquacrest Saber Hold) channels and releases up to 22 Dewdrop hits each consuming 4% of Traveler's current HP (gated above 50% HP). Each Dewdrop's per-hit FlatDmg scales with Traveler's MaxHP via dewdropBonus[lvl]. The HP-cost-per-tick + per-hit FlatDmg-on-MaxHP-scaling don't fit the schema's single-scaling damage Effect. The Hold-E variant is authored as a frame variant; per-tick damage and HP costs are not modeled.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Hold mode's up to 22 Dewdrop damage ticks and its HP drain — each Dewdrop scales with Max HP and costs 4% of current HP (only above 50% HP). Only the cast is shown.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate omission caveat: the Hold-E variant's per-tick damage and self-HP cost genuinely are not modeled (HP-cost-per-tick combined with per-hit flat-DMG-on-Max-HP scaling — composite HP-driven scaling on the CANNOT list, not wired), so rewrite rather than implementDelete. Compressed to the 'Not modeled' stock pattern; stripped the character/ability name (the panel already shows Skill + Aquacrest Saber) and the schema/field-name curator content; kept the decision-relevant magnitudes (up to 22 ticks, 4% current HP gated above 50%, Max-HP scaling). The Hold-E frames stay on the timeline, so 'Only the cast is shown' preserves the authored-as-frame-variant point.

verdicts.originalText: C2 (Liquid Drift) authored as a +3s durationModifier on the bubble summon (4s → 7s). The movement-speed -30% half (which would yield 14 ticks instead of 8 by slowing the drift to 0.7s/tile) is not authored — the planner ticks at the base 0.5s interval regardless.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the C2 -30% bubble movement-speed reduction — the slower drift isn't shown. Its +3s duration is applied, so damage ticks run at the base 0.5s interval over the full window.
verdicts.rationale: Mixed caveat: the C2 +3s duration extension is correctly modeled (working behavior) and the -30% movement-speed half is a real but low-impact omission — bubble movement isn't visualized for any summon. The '14 ticks vs 8' parenthetical conflates the tick count with the movement slow: per the curator notes the 14 ticks follow from the modeled 7s duration (7 / 0.5), not the speed reduction, so the timeline already ticks 14 times. I demote that reasoning and keep only the honest omission (slower drift not shown). Mixed content plus that ambiguity downgrades to rewrite rather than delete, so the movement-omission warning isn't silently dropped. Replaced the 'the planner ticks' voice with 'shown'/passive per the voice rule and dropped the 'durationModifier' camelCase term.
